nodes.name: Daily Trigger
nodes.notes: 13:00 Africa/Cairo daily. Month-to-date through yesterday. Sheets only, no email.

nodes.name: Monthly Trigger
nodes.notes: 14:00 on the 1st: after the 13:00 daily run and after raw sheets are filled. Previous full month, writes sheets AND emails.

nodes.name: Compute Period (Month-to-Date)
nodes.notes: Month-to-date through yesterday. Label like 1-4 Oct.

nodes.name: Compute Period (Previous Full Month)
nodes.notes: Monthly slice: previous full calendar month.

nodes.name: Read Raw Sheets
nodes.notes: ONE batchGet request reads all 4 raw tabs (Raw Sheets = source of truth). Errors are handled in Build Report so one bad brand cannot silently write zeros.

nodes.name: Build Report
nodes.notes: Parses raw tabs, filters ONLY the period (no fallback), validates, computes all 9 report tabs and builds one batchUpdate body.

nodes.name: Write Report Sheets
nodes.notes: Overwrites fixed ranges (titles + data + blank padding). Re-running never appends or duplicates.

nodes.name: Share Report Sheet
nodes.notes: Gives thebreadbutteragency@gmail.com Editor access to the brand report sheet after it is filled. Needs a Google Drive OAuth2 credential (full drive scope). Change role to "reader" for view-only.

nodes.name: Compose brand email
nodes.notes: TEST_MODE = true sends to the agency address only. Set false to email each brand.

parameters.subject: Error In WF3 GENERATE WEEKLY MONTHLY REPORTS

parameters.content:
## WF3 Ads Reports (fixed)
- Raw sheets = source of truth, read fresh every run
- Daily 13:00 -> 1st of month through yesterday (e.g. 1-4 Oct), sheets only
- Monthly 14:00 on the 1st -> previous full month, sheets + email
- Email TEST_MODE is ON in "Compose brand email"
- Workflow timezone must be Africa/Cairo (Settings)
